content.title: About
content.content: Ham Stroganoff is a ready‑to‑eat dish consisting of tender ham pieces simmered in a creamy tomato‑onion sauce with herbs and spices. It heats quickly and works as a standalone meal or as a filling for sandwiches, pasta, or rice.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The original Stroganoff was made with beef, but Soviet cuisine often substituted ham for faster preparation.
The creamy sauce typically contains sour cream or cream, giving the dish a mild, velvety taste.
Ham Stroganoff is commonly sold in vacuum‑sealed packs, extending shelf life without flavor loss.
It can be reheated in a microwave, which preserves the aroma of the spices.
The dish is popular in school cafeterias because of its quick preparation and nutritional value.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Ham provides high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron from ham helps maintain normal hemoglobin levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Ham supplies vitamin B12 and niacin, important for nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Calcium from cream
items.content: The creamy sauce adds calcium, supporting bone health.

items.title: Energy dense
items.content: The combination of protein and fat offers a quick source of energy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Ham often contains a lot of salt, so people with hypertension should limit portions.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: The cream sauce adds saturated fats, which can affect cholesterol levels if consumed excessively.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may have an allergy or intolerance to pork.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Ready‑made products may contain nitrites and other preservatives that should be considered in a diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat Ham Stroganoff in a microwave or skillet until hot. Serve with mashed potatoes, rice, pasta, or fresh bread. Garnish with chopped parsley or dill for extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package refrigerated at 0 °C – +4 °C. After opening, consume within 3‑4 days. When frozen, the product retains quality for up to 2 months; thaw in the refrigerator before reheating.
